decisions: WebMCP is the product surface and all diagnosis runs client-side.
Filesystem access requires a visible native browser permission; WebMCP never opens a picker implicitly.
Only bounded Codex/MCP config, package, instruction, and skill metadata inside the granted workspace are read.
Downloaded MCP code is never executed; static package evidence is not presented as live runtime state.
Only exact deterministic JSON duplicate actions can be applied after backup and explicit review.
When the page lacks host filesystem scope, WebMCP returns a bounded Codex host handoff; Codex requests native approval, uses host fs tools, and submits a sanitized snapshot back to the page.
